note: Researched from official registrar pages. "snippet" means only a search engine excerpt of an official page could be read; check those in a browser. euVat: whether the registrar adds VAT for EU consumers on top of its net price (missing = unknown). Feature cost "per": year, month or once; a "bundle" is paid once even if it covers several features.
